scope: Reviewed command intent group plus17 connected-mail intents. Downstream completion boundaries are requirements, not measured acceptance. Source bindings are not an exhaustive semantic denominator.

mail_navigation_20261114.scope: Web bindings byte-match193910 production capture; desktop bindings are current source only, without a paired native build claim.

whiteboard_actions_20261114.scope: Source-only review of45 shared board command/tool declarations plus21 gesture/lifecycle/review intents. Source bytes, not a combined build or semantic completeness, are pinned.

discovery_snapshot.scope: Latest pinned non-atomic source discovery:376 identities/1383 references; not a complete user-action denominator.

actions.label: Open smart scheduling
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Scheduling controls and their loaded/empty/error state are usable.

actions.label: Return from a saved thread to email

actions.label: Download an explicit mail attachment

actions.label: Sync connected Gmail
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Provider pages and cursor are durably saved, account/list refresh completes, and final status or recoverable error is usable.
actions.required_variants: Fresh/resume; multiple pages; expired/revoked/wrong account; rate/network/server failure; route leave; concurrent provider jobs.

actions.label: Sync connected Outlook
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Provider pages and cursor are durably saved, account/list refresh completes, and final status or recoverable error is usable.
actions.required_variants: Fresh/resume; delta reset; multiple pages; expired/revoked/wrong account; rate/network/server failure; route leave; concurrent provider jobs.

actions.label: Restart the selected provider sync
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Selected provider's restarted traversal reaches saved/current results or an actionable error.
actions.required_variants: Gmail/Outlook; old cursor; multiple pages; explicit restart intent; app-owned jobs and durable page cursor.

actions.label: Stop sync after the current page
actions.completion_boundary_to_verify: Current provider page commits, no next page starts, resumable cursor is retained, and refreshed list plus stopped status are usable.
actions.required_variants: Before connection/page request; during provider page; final page; restart/resume; route leave. Immediate HTTP abort is intentionally not this action's contract.
